I've pulled up your order Shop···· (Bitfortun BS-1, $277.13, delivered September 23). I checked it directly, and I have to be straight with you: the $50 partial refund has not been processed. A colleague is picking it up today, and you'll get the confirmation with the transaction details in this same thread once it's issued. Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Handed to the team · Needs JD: OTP enrollment behaviour on the BS-1 and whether the Harlo firmware up

Hi Luis,

Glad the $50 landed, and thanks for letting me know.

On the OTP enrollment, start with the firmware rather than leaving it for a month. A blank QR panel at the enrollment step is most often an older build, and updating is the first thing I'd try. Check which version your BS-1 is reporting on its dashboard and compare it against the latest release for your model at https://harlolabs.com, where the downloads, release notes and setup guides all live. If you're behind, update, reload the dashboard and run Start Enrollment again. One other thing worth trying before and after the update: open the dashboard in a different browser, or in a private window with ad blockers off, since the QR image sometimes gets blocked rather than never generated. If the panel offers a manual setup key next to the QR, you can type that straight into your authenticator app and it gives you the same result.

I've also passed this to JD, who handles the hardware and firmware side, so you'll get his read on whether the new Harlo build changes the OTP flow. The team is offline for the weekend and picks this up Monday at 10am ET, and his answer comes to you by email.

If you'd rather not wait, JD is very active on our Discord and that's the fastest route right now: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, he shows up there as JD with the Admin role.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Luis,

Happy to help, and good luck with the setup.

Try the firmware update and the browser change when you get a chance, and JD will come back to you here with his read on the OTP enrollment and whether the new Harlo build affects it. The team is off for the weekend, so that lands Monday from 10am ET onwards, straight to this email.

If you want an answer sooner, the Discord is the quickest way to reach him over the weekend: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate. It's also a good place to keep an eye on new firmware releases and what other BS-1 owners are running.

Enjoy the miner, and shout if anything else comes up.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
